text:
laura: Heads-up — enterprise customer asked for BYOK + 7yr audit-log retention. They also want an acceptance checklist for launch. thoughts?

sam: wow 7yrs is big. do we have a legal precedent? @sara-legal?

sara-legal: 7yrs can be required by some regulated customers (finance, gov), but we need scoped mapping: what constitutes ‘audit log’ vs PII. also retention vs export obligations. we should offer phased commitments.

ying: agree phased. suggest Phase 1 = BYOK key handshake + 90d immutable audit export (customer-managed export endpoint). Phase 2 = long-term retention + search/forensics API + KMS escrow options.

jordan: pragmatic +1. can we ship Phase 1 without full SOC2 scope change? keep it under current controls by treating long-term retention as an opt-in tenant feature (no org-wide policy).

matt: infra note — long-tail retention bumps storage and query costs and changes shard lifecycle. need SLOs for audit-search latency. proposed hard limits for Phase 1: retention_days: 90, export_endpoint: customers/v1/audit/export, export_format: ndjson.

laura: this is useful. let's sketch acceptance gates so sales can commit safely. initial idea: 1) BYOK handshake E2E test (key upload, envelope handshake) 2) Audit export works end-to-end (90d) 3) Config UI + CLI for tenant toggle 4) Legal signoff on data minimization docs 5) Customer pilot success (3 tenants)

sam: can we add a performance gate: export should complete for 90d tenant within X hours (maybe 2h per 100GB)?

matt: yes — add export SLA: 2h / 100GB for Phase 1. also add search SLOs deferred to Phase 2.

ying: also need key rotation doc + test vectors showing we can rotate without losing ability to decrypt existing audit blobs. acceptance: rotation test passes on pilot.

jordan: ops: how will oncall handle retention-related incidents? ops-bot can we add automated alerts for export failures and KMS API errors?

ops-bot: created alert policy "audit-export-failure" -> PagerDuty high if >5% failures over 10m. created metric dashboard template "Audit Retention - Phase1".

sara-legal: we need a checklist entry: "privacy notice and data mapping updated; legal hold process validated" before GA. Also confirm who signs off for exceptions.

laura: owner assignment proposal: Product (laura) owns acceptance criteria and pilot run, Eng infra (matt) owns export SLO + key rotation implementation, Eng security (ying) owns BYOK handshake and test vectors, Legal (sara-legal) owns compliance docs, Sales/CS will run pilot customers.

sam: timeline ask from sales: can we target pilot in 6 weeks and GA in 12? realistic?

matt: 6 weeks tight but ok for Phase 1 if we limit scope (90d retention + export only). need a small infra spike this week.

ying: will raise a design PR by EOW for handshake + rotation flow.

laura: next actions: 1) matt create infra spike ticket (owner: matt) 2) ying create design PR (owner: ying) 3) sara-legal list required docs and signoff matrix (owner: sara-legal) 4) laura prep pilot acceptance tests and share with sales. I'll post the acceptance checklist to the repo.

jordan: pls include rollback criteria: if export SLA breached for >48h across pilot tenants, pause feature for new tenants and rollback toggle.

laura: noted. adding rollback gate.

sam: thanks everyone. ping me if sales asks for customer-specific exceptions — we need to route to legal early. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder posted in #eng-oncall: runbook template for BYOK/audit retention available at https://confluence.redwood-inference/internal/byok-retention-runbook

laura: closing loop — I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday to review spike outcomes and confirm pilot candidates.

matt: 👍

ying: 👍

sara-legal: I'll prep the sign-off checklist and share by tomorrow.

sam: thanks — moving to action items.
